description_expanded: Looking for the perfect beach getaway on Scenic 30A? Blue Sky in Blue Mountain Beach offers everything you need for a luxurious, relaxing, and adventure-filled vacation. With a private heated pool, a stunning rooftop deck, and beautifully designed interiors, this home is designed for making unforgettable memories. Stunning Vacation Home Features: Prime Blue Mountain Beach Location – Nestled in a quiet, picturesque area just off Scenic 30A, with easy access to the beach. Private Heated Pool & Sundeck – Relax in the sunshine, take a refreshing dip, or lounge poolside with your favorite book. Spacious & Stylish Interiors – Designed for comfort and elegance, featuring cozy furnishings, an inviting atmosphere, and plenty of room to unwind. Fully Equipped Kitchen – Whether preparing a quick breakfast or a gourmet dinner, this beautifully appointed kitchen has everything you need. Comfortable, Well-Appointed Bedrooms – Enjoy restful nights in luxurious bedrooms designed for peace and relaxation. Breathtaking Rooftop Deck – A True Showstopper Panoramic 30A Views – Take in the gorgeous Gulf Coast scenery from one of the best spots in the house. Full Wet Bar – The perfect setup for mixing cocktails, chilling drinks, and entertaining guests. Built-in Gas Grill – Fire up a delicious cookout while enjoying the fresh ocean breeze. Large Dining Table with Ample Seating – Ideal for family meals, sunset dinners, or late-night gatherings under the stars. Plush Lounge Seating – Kick back and relax with a cold drink, good conversation, or a quiet moment to yourself. Blue Sky is within just a few miles of several popular restaurants, including Blue Mountain Beach Creamery, Mimmo’s Ristorante Italiano, AJ’s Grayton Beach, Hurrican Oyster Bar and Grill, Stinky’s Fish Camp, and Great Southern Cafe Nearby family-friendly attractions include Santa Rosa Golf & Beach Club, Point Washington State Forest, Shops at Gulf Place, Grayton Beach State Park, and the Timpoochee Trail. Requests for pool heating must be submitted at least a week prior to arrival and are subject to an additional $75 fee if requested within the week of arrival. Heating for pools is an additional $45 per day. Book your stay at this Scenic Stays property today and create lasting memories in this coastal paradise. Parties, events, bachelor and bachelorette parties are strictly prohibited, and an adult chaperone must accompany guests under 25 throughout their stay. Smoking is strictly forbidden, and pets are unfortunately not welcome and subject to immediate departure if found to be inhabiting a property. Guests found in violation are subject to eviction with no refund.
